Hi Neha —

Thanks for moving this forward. Attaching our PO spec (Medisys_PO_spec.xlsx) and a short questionnaire from procurement. A few clarification asks so our finance team can route the PO and payment: 

- Invoice recipient/entity: please confirm which legal entity Redwood will invoice (we need exact remittance name for our ERP).
- Net terms: are you able to accept Net 45 (we typically prefer Net 60 for larger pilots but procurement asked for 45)?
- Pricing appendix: there are two rows in your attached appendix ("Baseline" vs "Burst"). Can you confirm whether baseline tokens are billed monthly in arrears and bursts are billed as incurred?
- Taxes: for US customers we don’t collect VAT, but need to confirm whether Redwood requires any tax certificates or W-9/W-8 forms for invoicing.

We'd like to close commercials by end of week if possible so legal can attach the PO to the signed Order Form. Can you confirm and share a redline of the latest OrderForm if you have one?

Appreciate it —
Alice Morgan
Director, Strategic Procurement
Medisys Health

Hi Alice —

Thanks for the clear list and the PO spec. Looping in Ben (sales commercial lead) and Kimberly (finance/legal ops) to confirm the bits that need sign-off. Quick answers up front: 

- Invoice entity: Redwood invoices via "Redwood Inference, Inc." to the billing contact you provide; we can route to a specific Redwood entity if required by your AP team — please confirm the exact ERP name to match the PO.
- Net terms: standard for this deal is Net 45, that works for us. If procurement needs Net 60 we can review but will need to confirm internally.
- Pricing appendix: baseline rows are billed monthly in arrears; bursts are usage-based and billed monthly as incurred — we can add a line in the appendix to explicitly call that out.
- Taxes: for US entities we typically request a W-9. For cross-border customers we request VAT evidence; Kimberly will outline the exact evidence we need.

Ben / Kimberly — could you review the attached OrderForm_v2_redline.docx and confirm whether the minimum commit and invoicing language needs any tweaks? Alice — we'll send a redline back by tomorrow morning.

Best,

Hi Alice / Neha —

I took a pass on the OrderForm and the pricing appendix. Key commercial notes: 

1) Minimum commit: the MSA references a minimum commit in Exhibit A and the Order Form uses "Minimum Annual Commitment" language. To avoid mismatch, I propose we replace the phrase in the Order Form with the exact Exhibit A wording ("Minimum Annual Commitment (MAC)") and add an inline definition mapping to billing cadence. This prevents downstream confusion at renewal.

2) Billing cadence: confirm that MAC will be invoiced as an upfront pro-rated activation for the first invoice and monthly thereafter (we can also do a staggered schedule if you prefer). If Medisys wants all MAC invoiced up front we can provide crediting mechanics — note this affects revenue recognition and will need finance approval.

3) Net terms: Net 45 is acceptable. If procurement counters with Net 60, we will need a written approval from finance (Ben_C_finance@redwood.ai) and may request a small price premium.

4) Invoice recipient: please confirm the exact ERP payee name and the AP email (accounts.payable@medisys.co or a PO number mapping). We will match the invoice "Bill To" block exactly to avoid rejection.

I've attached a redline (OrderForm_v2_redline.docx) with the MAC wording and an explicit invoicing appendix. Kimberly — any tax/w-9 comments are below.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Attachments: OrderForm_v2_redline.docx

Hi Alice —

Additional finance/legal items from our side: 

- Tax / evidence: For US invoicing we ask customers to provide a W-9 (completed) so we have the correct tax classification on file. If Medisys is invoicing to a non-US entity, we will require either a local tax registration certificate or the VAT registration number.

- Invoice content: please include the PO number on the invoice and reference the Order Form number (OF-2025-MD-047). Our system will auto-reconcile only if PO and Invoice number match.

- Sample invoice: attaching a sample stub (sample_invoice_stub.pdf) so procurement can confirm format. If AP requires an alternate remit address, please send the exact text.

- Currency/tax treatment: confirm whether Medisys wants USD invoices (we prefer USD) or local currency; local currency invoices may trigger different tax handling.

If Medisys can provide the PO with the exact "Bill To" name and a completed W-9, we can produce the first invoice within 3 business days after contract countersignature.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Finance Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: sample_invoice_stub.pdf
